title: Investigating the mechanisms of yinchen in the treatment of immune hemolysis: Quercetin's role in complement inhibition and suppression of IL-6/STAT3 signaling.
authors: Bai, Le; Lang, Yuxiang; Zhang, Nannan; Li, Haiying; Zhong, Jintong; Peng, Xiaodan; Yang, Jiaojiao; He, Xueqin; Nian, Qing; Yu, Zebo; Hu, Xue
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药茵陈中槲皮素治疗免疫溶血的补体抑制与IL-6/STAT3信号通路机制，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Yinchen (YC), the dried aerial parts of the medicinal plant Artemisia capillaris Thunb. (family Asteraceae), is primarily distributed across the Asia-Pacific Region. Although YC exhibits clinically validated efficacy against immune hemolytic disorders, its mechanistic underpinnings remain insufficiently elucidated in pharmacological research. This study investigates the potential targets and mechanisms of YC in treating immune hemolysis based on network pharmacology and bioinformatic analysis. Additionally, it aims to verify quercetin's anti-complement activity and inhibition of IL-6-induced STAT3 activation, a key component of YC, through in vitro experiments, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations. 13 active components in YC with 143 putative targets were identified by Network pharmacology. Quercetin, beta-sitosterol, and isorhamnetin were top-ranked by target count. 1231 gene targets related to immune hemolysis, with 60 overlapping targets mapping to both YC and the disease were identified. Quercetin exhibited inhibitory activity against both classical and alternative complement pathways, with IC(50) values of 528.3 mg/L and 212.5 mg/L, respectively. Quercetin (80 muM) suppressed IL-6-induced IgG secretion and attenuated STAT3 signaling in murine splenic lymphocytes, as evidenced by decreased levels of STAT3 mRNA expression, STAT3 and phosphorylated STAT3 (p-STAT3) proteins. Molecular docking analysis revealed quercetin's putative binding affinity to key complement system components (C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C8, C9, Factor B) and IL-6, suggesting a dual mechanism of complement pathway modulation and IL-6/IL-6R interaction blockade. Simulation studies confirmed the stable interaction between C1s, C3, C5 and IL-6 and quercetin. Quercetin, a key component of Yinchen used in treating immune hemolysis, demonstrates anti-complement activity and can inhibit IL-6-induced STAT3 activation in vitro.
abstract_zh: 茵陈（YC）为药用植物茵陈蒿（Artemisia capillaris Thunb.，菊科）的干燥地上部分，主要分布于亚太地区。尽管YC在临床上对免疫溶血性疾病具有已验证的疗效，但其药理学研究中的机制基础仍未得到充分阐明。本研究基于网络药理学和生物信息学分析，探讨YC治疗免疫溶血的潜在靶点及机制。此外，旨在通过体外实验、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，验证YC关键成分槲皮素的抗补体活性及其对IL-6诱导的STAT3活化的抑制作用。通过网络药理学，鉴定出YC中13个活性成分及143个推定靶点。槲皮素、β-谷甾醇和异鼠李素按靶点数量排名居前。鉴定出与免疫溶血相关的1231个基因靶点，其中60个重叠靶点同时映射至YC和该疾病。槲皮素对经典和替代补体途径均表现出抑制活性，其IC(50)值分别为528.3 mg/L和212.5 mg/L。槲皮素（80 μM）抑制了小鼠脾淋巴细胞中IL-6诱导的IgG分泌，并减弱了STAT3信号传导，表现为STAT3 mRNA表达水平、STAT3及磷酸化STAT3（p-STAT3）蛋白水平的降低。分子对接分析揭示了槲皮素与关键补体系统组分（C1、C2、C3、C4、C5、C8、C9、因子B）及IL-6的推定结合亲和力，提示其具有补体途径调节和IL-6/IL-6R相互作用阻断的双重机制。模拟研究确认了C1s、C3、C5及IL-6与槲皮素之间的稳定相互作用。槲皮素作为茵陈治疗免疫溶血的关键成分，表现出抗补体活性，并能在体外抑制IL-6诱导的STAT3活化。
